general_information.name: UM… SORRY, DO YOU MEAN LIKE MY FULL NAME ON THE FORMS? I’M NOT REALLY SURE WHAT PART YOU WANT FIRST. IT’S MARIA… AND THE LAST NAME IS GONZALEZ, I THINK THAT’S WHAT’S ON THINGS.

current_concerns.primary_problems: I’ve been really low and… just so tired all the time. Everything feels heavy, and I’m overwhelmed with the baby and my toddler. It’s like I can’t keep up, and I feel guilty too… like, after the pregnancy and all.
current_concerns.goals: I just want to feel like myself again, honestly. And be able to cope better, and look after the kids without feeling like I’m falling apart.
